reading.title: PILOT Agreement Approval for Cottage City Towers Apartments

signatures.party: Prince George's County Government Office of the County Executive

candidates.quote: The Owner is an entity to be formed by Developer: HAPGC Affordable Housing Development Corporation, LLC C/O Housing Authority of Prince George's County for the purpose of acquiring and rehabilitating the Project, which is an existing one hundred (100) unit affordable multi-family rental housing for low-income to moderate-income families, known as Cottage City Towers, located at 4142 Bunker Hill Road, Cottage City, Maryland 20722.
All units will be reserved for households earning sixty percent (60%) or less of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).
candidates.wording: reserved for households earning sixty percent (60%) or less

candidates.quote: The PILOT will exempt the Owner from making a mandatory annual property tax payment to the County and will remain in effect for a period of at least forty (40) years.
